placements.title: Immediate Receipt And Polled Cursors Eliminate Blocking And Lost Work
placements.frame: How does the async job contract for remember structure non-blocking dispatch, cursor polling, and result delivery?
placements.why: Ratifying an immediate-return receipt with cursor polling decouples dispatch from extraction completion, eliminating blocking calls and lost work.
